result: An explicitly configured memory-snapshot@1 Stage exports selected current-Run logical notes into a frozen ordinary canonical JSON Artifact, without a Planner, Runtime allocation or model. Replay returns the original exact version before mutable note reads.

checks.notes: Both named targets share the same complete Findings family once per make invocation. The snapshot case observes all selected content and no ignored note; a Workflow without the operation exports nothing. Snapshot Stage has no Planner session or allocation; only the three ordinary Workers account for 15 scripted calls including existing result finalizers.
